prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / game spell-card illustration pilot. Produce ONE review contact sheet containing exactly THREE DISTINCT PAINTED ILLUSTRATIONS in three equal side-by-side square panels. Target aspect ratio 3:1, ideally 1536x512. Each panel fills its own equal third completely; straight vertical boundaries, no gutters, no frames, no text anywhere. The input image is ONLY a reference for the established Wabish midnight arcade palette and tactile 2D materials. Do NOT copy its UI layout, shelves, card text, buttons, glyphs, menus, or product prices.

Art direction: rich polished 2D high-resolution game art, worn deep navy arcade plastic, smoke-dark glass, aged teal enamel, warm cream die faces, restrained brass and amber electronic light, clear chunky silhouettes, selective edge wear and soft cel-painted volume. This is evocative card-face artwork with a recognizable subject, NOT an abstract icon, text panel, pictogram, wireframe, or literal screenshot. Mature playful dice roguelite, no human characters. Every subject reads at a small landscape crop. Concentrate the key subject within the middle 80 percent of each square so it can be used on a card. Equal panel scale and illumination. Existing arcade direction overrides legacy medieval royal/parchment/daylight style.

LEFT PANEL, art for '冲关增幅': a stout cream-and-teal physical die in an old arcade amplifier socket, a compact bright amber energy burst breaking through a short glass scoring threshold behind it. Dynamic but clear single subject, punchy upward surge, tiny brass contacts, a few bright sparks. No numbers, no readable labels, no pips pretending to be a roll result.
MIDDLE PANEL, art for '连锁分红': a small sequence of three linked amber relay lights activating a chunky old arcade coin payout mechanism, several warm brass coins tumbling into a shallow dark teal tray. The image should feel like a chain of mechanisms producing coins. No numbers or text, no casino jackpot graphics, no large light trails across the entire composition.
RIGHT PANEL, art for '回声指令': one solid cream-and-teal die beside a translucent amber echo impression of the same die, housed in a simple old arcade signal repeater with two clearly readable pulse rings. A restrained repeated mechanical signal, clear solid original and lighter repeated copy. No printed numbers, no readable labels, no pips, no science-fiction holographic dashboard.

Constraints: exactly three equal square illustration areas in a single wide strip, no card border or typography, no captions or logos or watermark. No knight/crown/parchment, no neon cyberpunk, no slot reels, no photorealistic 3D render, no childish character faces. Designed to insert as image art into existing spell cards; final Chinese names/prices/tooltips will be drawn separately by the UI.
